description:
Use this when the user asks about the India VIX, the NSE volatility index, today or over a period.

NSE's daily India VIX (volatility index) OHLC time series.

    `from_date`/`to_date` are optional ISO dates (default: trailing ~30 days; window capped at
    1825 days). Each row is `{trade_date, open, high, low, close, points_change, pct_change}` —
    VIX has no P/E, P/B, dividend yield, volume, or turnover, so those keys are omitted rather
    than returned null.
name: get_india_vix
title: India VIX
